name: Tara Poulton

items.text: At an April 2026 candidate forum, Poulton said she hasn't taken developer money and doesn't plan to. An opponent noted a $1,000 gift from the Grimes Galvano law firm, which often represents developers. Poulton confirmed it and called Bill Galvano a longtime friend. She also took $400 from an architecture firm.
items.why: The reporting confirms a maximum gift from a law firm that represents developers, but no donor is shown to be a developer and no finding shows her statement was false, so it doesn't clearly bear on lying about her record or on big-money influence (criteria 3 and 6).
No foreign-government, foreign-parent, lobbying or paid-travel conduct by this person was found for criterion 2, so there is nothing to weigh.

for_review: I could not find or open the Florida campaign finance records for the Gulf Coast Builders Exchange PAC and McClure Properties/Holdings gifts named in item 1. The Observer and Bradenton Times articles I read don't mention them. The Bradenton Times says the only PAC gift came from Knowledge Is Power, and Poulton told a forum her donors included 'one PAC'. Check her Manatee Supervisor of Elections filings (voterfocus) to confirm donors and amounts. The searches on the owner's named sites returned nothing about Poulton. I found no other against-level or open-level items. A guest column on the Bradenton Journal substack called her a 'developer candidate'. That is opinion, so I did not rely on it.
